info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

parcels.desc: Parcel is only about 2000 square feet in size. Too small for construction. And part of that is underneath the road right-of-way. Not much here left for use.

Small vacant parcel of land near Gulliver Lake on CR 432. ~50' x 133' feet in size. Topographical maps tell us this is uplands, but our eyes see cat-tails at the roadside. You might want to give it a walk in person to see if it meets your needs. ~1/3 of an acre on a paved county road just a few hundred feet south of US 2.

Interested bidders should contact the local branch of government regarding possible development and or other use restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement, utilities, etc.

Older wood frame home in Manistique. There is some debris to remove here, but it's the "clean" kind and not too stanky or gross. We *think* there is a basement under this one, but we did not find access inside. So it is either under one of the piles or it is under the mound outside the back wall. This is a square 40 ... mostly marshland/recreational property. It is on a GATED road called "Big Bear Lane" that runs off US 2. We did not have access to this road. The parcel sits about a half mile up the gated road. Topo maps suggest that there are some uplands here when you reach the property, but it has marshlands to the NE and SW corners.
